meta.objective: Organize the current V4 data and result surfaces across paper-audit and native conceptual-study lanes, identify which conceptual setups are runnable now versus blocked on missing bundle/spec work, and leave the repo ready for a controlled next launch phase before broader provider expansion.

notes: Live own-dev contains 22 completed V4 experiments, including canaries and reruns.
The local source/build layer is already complete for Gilardi and Zheng.
The conceptual-study lane is runnable on the current substrate, but no native conceptual manifest or curated universe has been created yet.
The inventory surface exposed duplicate Gilardi universe/set tags and a small number of multi-run experiment rows.

current.label: paper_audit_launch_plus_inventory
current.summary: The V4 paper-audit lane is launched and analyzed. The repo now also has a repeatable inventory/export surface and an explicit native conceptual-study readiness map.

workflowRuns.requestedObjective: Inventory the current live and local V4 artifacts, separate paper-audit assets from native conceptual-study surfaces, identify which conceptual setups can run now versus which are blocked on missing bundle/spec work, and produce implementation-facing manifests/docs for the next launch phase.
Resolve the duplicate Gilardi catalog rows if they still matter, then define the first GPT-4.1-only native conceptual-study manifest and evidence-universe creation plan.

bottlenecks: Duplicate Gilardi universe/set tags should be cleaned before the next broader launch pass.
The native conceptual-study lane still lacks a frozen manifest and curated evidence universe.
Semantic cluster bundle strategies remain blocked in V4 evidence-set-backed runs.

decisions.statement: Use a separate workspace from the paper-audit launch campaign so data organization and native conceptual readiness do not get buried inside rerun/claim work.
Treat the paper-audit lane, local source/build artifacts, and native conceptual-study queue as distinct inventories.
Do not broaden provider families until the native conceptual queue starts with a GPT-4.1-only launch slice.
